correctness.rationale: Canonical union-irreducible singleton/doubleton generators yield exact weights C(n,s)2^{-s(s−1)/2}. Ratios w_{s+1}/w_s=((n−s)/(s+1))2^-s anchor uniquely at q solving (q+1)2^q=n. For centered j the oriented products expand log(w_{m+j}/w_m)=(ln2)F_theta(j)+F_theta(j)/(m+1)+uniform second-order error on a central window. Monotone ratios give uniform quadratic tails and summable remainder, while normalization replaces F by F−mu, proving global ℓ1 O((m+1)^-2). Independently compared exact weights at n=4096,65536,1048576: leading ℓ1 errors about .0661,.0493,.0414 versus corrected .0112,.00459,.00438. Finite checks corroborate; the uniform tail estimates prove the asymptotic.
